notes.title: Saturday Weekly Patch Round Up
notes.content:
A ton. Check out the videos below for an indepth dive for each feature!


 Physicality Avatar Body for Fae (users), allows for running/jumping/climbing trees/etc
 OpenXR support in steam client.
 Shader overhaul for adding queues about range and depth
 Noise creation with simple tracker.

notes.title: Fae Physics - Running / Jumping / Climbing Buildings
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=aSyc7p6UXU0;full][/previewyoutube]

New Build! Fae Physics and Hands!

Patch Notes

 Added range markers in the form of lighting at 5 / 15 / 30 units. You can see this especially in the tree leaves. 
 Running, Jumping, Climbing buildings watching the mosh pits while you're up there.
 Added a gradient light around your finger tips.
 Pumpkins!
 Hands for everyone/OpenXR Support.
 Massive Lighting/Shader updates.

notes.title: Weave Fate with an additional Music Focused Spell for your Grimoire
notes.content:
Added new spell: DO_SEEK
> Loop music or skip around in the track to remix
> Does not reset the fate generation 

Travel between REALMS in an OVERWORLD playing music even between border crossings. It'll keep where you left off.

notes.title: Another thEiAoLoGy update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252395/2b6c20894537252f988cb91bcd3e600e1fa8ae6f.gif
Vox Grouping allows for atoms to be physically grouped together for velocity/thrust. They can also be broken apart.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252395/5ab49989635acdc493800302a0408d71678227e0.png

Time Formating on LISP script is now h : m : s


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41252395/78ca9b50fb83d8986957b95c4e3a0c1457349029.png
Score is being showing in the top right corner, this can be increased with do_score. Plan is to use traps to increase score based on criteria. Also I want to show score in-game rather than via UI but this is proof of concept.
